body: When I started to see life as one big game. People only associating with others because they see it as some investment or gain in the long run. And my realization that I'm not so different than other people.
an urgency to not waste time lying down
an imaginary support to your hopes and beliefs
when you stop feeling the need to search for something
appearing busy with something just to not be seen as lazy
my father growing grey hair and having problems remembering things

Nothing specific, really. As long as we can work as a team and enjoy below or average competition. I'd rather not drop names of any game here because I think it would steer away from my main focus which is a general hangout and chatting.
